- Requests above the provisioned slots, up to `MaxConcurrency`, still run on-demand and can cold start.
- You can use Application Auto Scaling to scale Provisioned Concurrency with your traffic profile, for example to hold it higher in business hours.

- Provisioned Concurrency is a standing cost, because warm capacity is reserved whether or not it's used. I didn't pull the pricing page, so check current rates for your Region before deciding.
